title: desmodium williamsii var. magnibracteatum
intro: Desmodium williamsii var. magnibracteatum, commonly known as Wild Sweetpea, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing fever, inflammation, and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Wild Sweetpea include anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Studies have also identified the presence of glycosides, terpenoids, and phenolic acids in this plant, which contribute to its bioactive properties.
